command: set -euo pipefail; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; echo CURRENT=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true); nvm install 22; echo NODE22=$(nvm exec 22 node -v); echo WS=$(nvm exec 22 node -e 'process.stdout.write(typeof WebSocket)'); echo DEFAULT=$(nvm alias default 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 || true); timeout 25s nvm exec 22 npx -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote || rc=$?; echo REMOTE_RC=${rc:-0}
